description: Regrid sells standardised parcel data with boundaries across the United States and Canada, with growing coverage in more than 20 European countries, in one unified schema. Add-ons include matched building footprints, matched secondary addresses, standardised zoning, daily ownership updates and U.S. roadway right-of-way polygons, delivered as bulk files, a feature service, a parcel API and tiles, or through a data store and a property app; an MCP server is offered for AI tools. Industries served include architecture and construction, real estate, government, insurance, utilities, broadband and logistics, and a Data with Purpose programme is listed. Coverage: the United States and Canada, and parts of Europe. Access: commercial products; the property app and data store for smaller purchases. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: parcel attributes come from county and government records and vary in completeness by county. Simulation uses are joining buildings to parcels, ownership and land value for exposure and planning studies. Related records: ATTOM property data and NYC PLUTO.
